known_gaps: No exhaustive typeface inventory for every Secret Lair/showcase and Universes Beyond treatment.
Nine print-set cohorts are not a count of distinct fonts.
Goudy/Matrix/Beleren/rules cuts are sampled through scans; not every font weight/style/glyph has independent held-out evidence.
No verified non-Latin or Phyrexian-script recognition.
Physical camera blur, glare, foil reflections and perspective need a separate benchmark.
Confidence is not calibrated to correctness.
